summary: Build digital employee-record workflows, access controls, and digitization plans in five days. Explore the paperless HR course and enrol.
lede: Paperless HR records management helps HR teams turn employee-file processes into controlled digital workflows. This training is for HR records officers, HR operations managers, HRIS administrators, and others responsible for employee records and service workflows. Participants practise building records inventories and classifications, checking digitization quality, and designing access controls and workflows for digital files.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for employee records, HR service workflows, and the information controls that support digital HR operations.
modules: HR Digitization, OCR and Quality Control
Automated HR Workflows and AI-Assisted OCR
prerequisites: Recommended: working knowledge of HR operations or employee-record handling. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel and Word for worksheet-based exercises; advanced AI-assisted OCR topics receive operational overview coverage, not technical implementation training.
